steps.title: Clear the old picture
steps.say: Let's drop the shifted curve and use one plain idea: demand rising means more buyers want the product at the same price.

ops.text: Demand rises = more buyers want it at the SAME price

steps.title: A number example
steps.say: Say at price 5, 10 people wanted to buy. Now 20 people want to buy at that same price.

ops.text: At price 5:  before = 10 buyers   after = 20 buyers

steps.title: Why price goes up
steps.say: At the old price there are more buyers than sellers want to supply, so the price rises until it reaches the new equilibrium.

ops.text: Too many buyers at the old price → price rises → new equilibrium at higher P
